requirements.description: The user explicitly specified a minimum gross floor area of 850 sqm.

The user prefers energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through A4, B and C. The user's other requirements (at least 850 sqm gross floor area, capacity for 60 people, proximity to public transport, Turin location) are not energy-related or not among the available columns, so no filters were created for them.
User prefers proximity to public transport. Expressed as a convenience need, so the threshold is the 75th percentile (70.93, rounded to 71).
A university student residence is strongly tied to nearby universities and schools, so education proximity is essential for this project type. Threshold is the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75).
